body_content.text: Right On Plumbing, Heating and Air serves the gated **Wyeth Ranch** community in northwest Las Vegas (89149), where homes built by Lennar and related builders between 2003 and 2007 are now reaching the age where original water heaters, fixtures, and piping start to fail. We know this neighborhood's larger two-story homes, the hard water from the Las Vegas Valley Water District, and the gate-access coordination needed to get a service truck to your door quickly. Whether you have a failing tank water heater, a pinhole leak under the slab, or scale-clogged faucets, our licensed plumbers handle the conditions specific to Wyeth Ranch homes.
Call now for fast, vetted plumbing service in Wyeth Ranch.
Plumbing Services for Wyeth Ranch Homes

Most Wyeth Ranch homes still run original tank water heaters from the 2003–2007 build era — now 18 to 22 years old and well past their 10–12 year lifespan. Las Vegas hard water speeds up scale and tank corrosion, so failures here are common. We replace failing tanks, install higher-capacity or relocated units that meet current code and HOA equipment standards, and convert larger multi-bath homes to tankless for continuous hot water using existing Southwest Gas service.

Wyeth Ranch is supplied by the Las Vegas Valley Water District, which delivers very hard, chlorinated water. That mineral content scales water heaters, clogs faucet aerators, and shortens the life of premium fixtures. Quality-conscious homeowners here protect their plumbing with water softeners and whole-house filtration.

Two decades of aggressive hard water exposure leaves Wyeth Ranch's original copper and early piping prone to pinhole leaks, while slab foundations raise the risk of hidden slab leaks. We use non-invasive leak detection to find problems before they damage flooring and drywall, repair failing pipe sections, and offer whole-home repiping as a long-term fix for homes seeing recurring leaks.

The builder-grade Moen and Delta fixtures installed across Wyeth Ranch during construction are corroding from hard water — aerators clog, cartridges fail, and original low-efficiency toilets waste water. We repair and upgrade faucets, install modern high-efficiency toilets, and service aging flush valves and fill mechanisms in 18-plus year old bathrooms.

Wyeth Ranch's larger, upscale homes — many 2,500 to 4,500-plus square feet with multiple full baths — are prime candidates for master-bath remodels that update original 2000s-era fixtures, layouts, and plumbing.

With Southwest Gas service throughout the neighborhood, gas line work supports the outdoor kitchens, pool heaters, and gas appliance upgrades common in these larger homes, plus repairs to lines feeding gas furnaces and water heaters as fittings age.

Twenty years of buildup, grease, and hard-water scale lead to slow and clogged drains throughout Wyeth Ranch kitchens and baths. As sewer laterals age amid the valley's expansive soils, we use camera inspections to catch root intrusion and offsets early and repair cracked or settled lines connecting to the municipal sewer system.

Failing 20-year-old water heaters and pipe bursts in Wyeth Ranch create urgent situations. We offer same-day and emergency response, and we coordinate gate access so our plumbers reach your home fast when minutes matter.

Wyeth Ranch is an upscale, family-oriented gated community in the northwest Las Vegas valley, sitting near the 215 Beltway west of the Durango Drive and Elkhorn Road intersection in ZIP code 89149. Developed primarily by Lennar Homes between 2003 and 2007, it features semi-custom and production single-family homes — many two-story, with attached three-car garages, second-floor laundry, and multiple full bathrooms on generous lots.

The community sits close to Centennial Hills and the Centennial Center shopping area, with easy access toward Kyle Canyon Gateway and Mount Charleston. Homes are served by municipal water from the Las Vegas Valley Water District, Clark County and City of Las Vegas sewer (not septic), and natural gas from Southwest Gas. As an active HOA community, Wyeth Ranch governs exterior modifications and condenser screening, and service vehicles need gate access codes or permissions to enter. Homeowners here tend to invest in their properties and value vetted contractors, warranties, and long-term solutions over quick fixes.
Right On Plumbing, Heating and Air serves Wyeth Ranch alongside the wider northwest Las Vegas valley, including the Centennial Hills and Durango Drive corridor neighborhoods nearby.
